|translation='''Title:''' Tantive IV.

'''Card text:''' May add 3 pilots and 4 passengers. Has docking capability. A permanent pilot with ability 2 is aboard. May deploy at any system (even without personnel and Force icons).

'''Lore:''' Diplomatic ship of Alderaan's ruling family. Princess Leia used it for her duties as an Imperial senator (and for secret Rebel missions). Captured by Devastator in orbit over Tatooine.
